title: bellis perennis proles pumila
intro: Bellis perennis proles pumila, commonly known as the dwarf daisy or dwarf English daisy, is a low-growing perennial plant belonging to the daisy family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may aid in wound healing, skin conditions, and even certain types of cancer. The therapeutic actions of Bellis perennis proles pumila include acting as an analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic, making it a potential treatment for various conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
